halfLife.notes: Steady state in ~7 days. Generally clean PK. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: S-desmethylcitalopram
activeMetabolite.notes: Far weaker than parent; not clinically significant for switching. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Minor inhibition of CYP2D6; not generally a concern when switching. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

maoiWashout.notes: Standard 14-day washout in both directions. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: Moderate discontinuation symptom risk; lower than paroxetine or venlafaxine. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Tablets widely available in Malaysia. Liquid drops in some pharmacies. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
